column1: Persistent bullying is one of the worst experiences a child can face.
column2: 长期遭受欺凌，是孩子可能面对的最糟糕的经历之一。
column5: one of the worst|最糟糕的……之一

column1: How can it be prevented?
column2: 怎样才能预防这种欺凌？

column1: Peter Smith, Professor of Psychology at the University of Sheffield, directed the Sheffield Anti-Bullying Intervention Project, funded by the Department for Education.
column2: 谢菲尔德大学心理学教授彼得·史密斯主持了谢菲尔德反欺凌干预项目，该项目由教育部资助。

column1: Here he reports on his findings.
column2: 他在这里介绍这项研究的结果。

column1: Bullying can take a variety of forms, from the verbal - being taunted or called hurtful names - to the physical - being kicked or shoved - as well as indirect forms, such as being excluded from social groups.
column2: 欺凌有多种形式，既有言语上的，如被奚落或被起侮辱性的绰号，也有肢体上的，如被踢或被推搡，还有间接形式，如被排斥在群体之外。

column1: A survey I conducted with Irene Whitney found that in British primary schools up to a quarter of pupils reported experience of bullying, which in about one in ten cases was persistent.
column2: 我与艾琳·惠特尼进行的调查发现，在英国小学，多达四分之一的学生报告曾遭受欺凌，其中约十分之一的情况是持续发生的。
column6: up to a quarter|多达四分之一
column9: experience of bullying|n. 遭受欺凌的经历
column10: about one in ten cases|约每十例中有一例

column1: There was less bullying in secondary schools, with about one in twenty-five suffering persistent bullying, but these cases may be particularly recalcitrant.
column2: 中学里的欺凌现象较少，约每二十五名学生中有一人长期受欺凌，但这些情况可能格外难以解决。
column4: one in twenty-five|每二十五人中有一人

column1: Bullying is clearly unpleasant, and can make the child experiencing it feel unworthy and depressed.
column2: 遭受欺凌当然不好受，还可能让孩子觉得自己毫无价值，心情低落。

column1: In extreme cases it can even lead to suicide, though this is thankfully rare.
column2: 在极端情况下，欺凌甚至可能导致自杀，所幸这种情况很少见。

column1: Victimised pupils are more likely to experience difficulties with interpersonal relationships as adults, while children who persistently bully are more likely to grow up to be physically violent, and convicted of anti-social offences.
column2: 受过欺凌的学生长大后更容易遇到人际关系方面的困难，而那些持续欺凌他人的孩子，成年后更可能有暴力行为，也更可能因危害社会的违法行为而被定罪。
column3: Victimised pupils|n. 受欺凌的学生
column9: physically violent|adj. 使用肢体暴力的
column11: anti-social offences|n. 危害社会的违法行为

column1: Until recently, not much was known about the topic, and little help was available to teachers to deal with bullying.
column2: 直到不久前，人们对欺凌的了解仍然有限，教师在应对欺凌时也很少能得到帮助。
column4: not much was known|人们了解得不多

column1: Perhaps as a consequence, schools would often deny the problem.
column2: 或许正因如此，学校过去常常否认存在欺凌问题。

column1: ‘There is no bullying at this school’ has been a common refrain, almost certainly untrue.
column2: “我们学校没有欺凌。”这话常常听到，可几乎可以肯定并不属实。

column1: Fortunately more schools are now saying: ‘There is not much bullying here, but when it occurs we have a clear policy for dealing with it.’
column2: 所幸，如今越来越多的学校这样说：“我们这里欺凌现象不多，但一旦发生，我们有明确的处理办法。”

column1: Three factors are involved in this change.
column2: 这一转变与三个因素有关。

column1: First is an awareness of the severity of the problem.
column2: 首先，人们认识到了问题的严重性。

column1: Second, a number of resources to help tackle bullying have become available in Britain.
column2: 其次，英国已经有了多种帮助学校应对欺凌的资源。
column6: have become available|已经可以获得

column1: For example, the Scottish Council for Research in Education produced a package of materials, Action Against Bullying, circulated to all schools in England and Wales as well as in Scotland in summer 1992, with a second pack, Supporting Schools Against Bullying, produced the following year.
column2: 例如，苏格兰教育研究委员会编制了一套名为《反欺凌行动》的资料，于1992年夏天分发给英格兰、威尔士和苏格兰的所有学校。次年，委员会又编制了第二套资料《支持学校反欺凌》。
column3: Scottish Council for Research in Education|n. 苏格兰教育研究委员会
column5: a package of materials|一套资料

column1: In Ireland, Guidelines on Countering Bullying Behaviour in Post-Primary Schools was published in 1993.
column2: 爱尔兰于1993年出版了《中学应对欺凌行为指南》。

column1: Third, there is evidence that these materials work, and that schools can achieve something.
column2: 第三，有证据表明这些资料确实管用，学校也确实可以取得成效。
column3: there is evidence that|有证据表明

column1: This comes from carefully conducted ‘before and after’ evaluations of interventions in schools, monitored by a research team.
column2: 这些证据来自对学校干预措施实施前后所作的细致评估，整个过程由研究团队跟踪。

column1: In Norway, after an intervention campaign was introduced nationally, an evaluation of forty-two schools suggested that, over a two-year period, bullying was halved.
column2: 挪威在全国开展干预行动后，对四十二所学校的评估显示，在两年间，这些学校的欺凌现象减少了一半。
column8: over a two-year period|在两年间

column1: The Sheffield investigation, which involved sixteen primary schools and seven secondary schools, found that most schools succeeded in reducing bullying.
column2: 谢菲尔德的调查涉及十六所小学和七所中学。调查发现，大多数学校成功减少了欺凌行为。

column1: Evidence suggests that a key step is to develop a policy on bullying, saying clearly what is meant by bullying, and giving explicit guidelines on what will be done if it occurs, what records will be kept, who will be informed, what sanctions will be employed.
column2: 证据表明，关键一步是制定反欺凌政策，明确界定什么是欺凌，并给出清楚的指引：一旦发生欺凌，该怎么处理、做哪些记录、通知谁、采取哪些惩戒措施。

column1: The policy should be developed through consultation, over a period of time - not just imposed from the head teacher’s office!
column2: 这项政策应经过一段时间的协商制定，而不能只是由校长把政策强加给大家。
column6: over a period of time|经过一段时间

column1: Pupils, parents and staff should feel they have been involved in the policy, which needs to be disseminated and implemented effectively.
column2: 学生、家长和教职工都应该感到自己参与了政策的制定。这项政策还需要有效地传达给大家，并切实执行。

column1: Other actions can be taken to back up the policy.
column2: 还可以采取其他行动来配合这项政策。

column1: There are ways of dealing with the topic through the curriculum, using video, drama and literature.
column2: 课堂上也可以借助视频、戏剧和文学作品来探讨欺凌。

column1: These are useful for raising awareness, and can best be tied in to early phases of development, while the school is starting to discuss the issue of bullying.
column2: 这些方法有助于提高大家对欺凌的认识，最好在制定对策之初、学校刚开始讨论欺凌问题时就把它们结合进来。
column8: issue of bullying|n. 欺凌问题

column1: They are also useful in renewing the policy for new pupils, or revising it in the light of experience.
column2: 在面向新生重新推行这项政策，或根据经验修订政策时，这些教学方法也很有用。
column7: in the light of|根据；鉴于

column1: But curriculum work alone may only have short-term effects; it should be an addition to policy work, not a substitute.
column2: 不过，只靠课程教学，效果可能只能维持一时。课程应该补充学校的反欺凌政策，无法取代政策本身。
column7: policy work|n. 政策方面的工作

column1: There are also ways of working with individual pupils, or in small groups.
column2: 还可以单独辅导学生，或以小组形式开展工作。

column1: Assertiveness training for pupils who are liable to be victims is worthwhile, and certain approaches to group bullying such as ‘no blame’, can be useful in changing the behaviour of bullying pupils without confronting them directly, although other sanctions may be needed for those who continue with persistent bullying.
column2: 对容易受欺凌的学生，教他们坚定表达立场是值得的。应对集体欺凌时，一些方法（如“不责备法”）有助于在避免正面对质的情况下改变施欺学生的行为，但对那些一再欺凌他人的学生，可能还需要其他惩戒措施。
column3: Assertiveness training|n. 坚定表达立场的训练

column1: Work in the playground is important, too.
column2: 在操场上开展反欺凌工作也很重要。

column1: One helpful step is to train lunchtime supervisors to distinguish bullying from playful fighting, and help them break up conflicts.
column2: 一种有帮助的做法是培训午间值勤人员，使他们分得清欺凌和嬉闹，并帮助他们及时制止冲突。
column3: helpful step|n. 有帮助的做法
column5: lunchtime supervisors|n. 午间值勤人员

column1: Another possibility is to improve the playground environment, so that pupils are less likely to be led into bullying from boredom or frustration.
column2: 另一个办法是改善操场环境，让学生不大容易因为无聊或受挫而去欺凌他人。
column7: be led into|受诱因影响而做

column1: With these developments, schools can expect that at least the most serious kinds of bullying can largely be prevented.
column2: 有了这些进展，学校有理由期待，至少最严重的几类欺凌可以在很大程度上得到预防。

column1: The more effort put in and the wider the whole school involvement, the more substantial the results are likely to be.
column2: 投入的精力越多，全校参与得越广泛，就越有可能取得显著成效。
column6: whole school involvement|n. 全校参与

column1: The reduction in bullying - and the consequent improvement in pupil happiness - is surely a worthwhile objective.
column2: 减少欺凌，并由此让学生过得更快乐，无疑是个值得追求的目标。
